hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: All cells in any column must share the same digit, and adjacent columns must have differing digits.

hints.title: Cost per Column
hints.text: If column c is assigned digit d, the number of modifications required is m minus the count of times digit d already appears in column c.

hints.title: State Transition
hints.text: Maintain dp[d] as the minimum modifications through the current column ending with digit d, taking the minimum over all distinct previous column digits.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan per column combined with constant 10x10 state transitions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Branching over 10^n column digit assignments causes exponential blowup.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space using 10-element state arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate column assignment as dynamic programming over ten digit choices.
